correctness.rationale: A fixed pattern occurs precisely when its independent geometric greedy-match waiting times sum to at most n. The probability GF has factor (1-z)^{-1}. Summing one indicator per distinct palindrome gives U+V over 1-V. For q>=2, V is strictly increasing from 0 to q on [0,1], and positivity of all coefficients in degrees >=2 makes the root r the unique smallest-modulus pole and yields the stated positive residue. At z=4/5, \(\pi-(4\pi/(1+4\pi))^2=\pi(4\pi-1)^2/(1+4\pi)^2\ge0\); equality demands four equal masses. Independently implemented exact enumeration of 15091 source words and symbolic four-letter GF check passed; finite checks do not establish infinite claims.

value.rationale: Distinct scattered palindromes are an explicitly studied invariant (Mahalingam–Pandoh 2021), and expectation for distinct scattered subsequences under biased random sources is an independently motivated subject (Biers-Ariel et al. 2017). The new joint object yields an exact first-moment GF for all finite alphabets and a sharp all-alphabet distribution optimizer: unexpectedly four equally likely letters, not arbitrarily many or the binary case, maximize mean exponential complexity with rate 5/4. The rigidity identity supplies a usable structural boundary and is not a mere finite enumeration, arbitrary narrow slice, or restatement of known deterministic maxima.
